page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core, ensuring consistent compute performance without resource sharing at the thread level.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating reliable data transfer rates for distributed workloads.

This hardware profile is designed for general-purpose workloads that require substantial compute and memory resources without specialized acceleration. It is suitable for applications such as medium-to-large databases, enterprise application hosting, web serving, and general-purpose business logic processing.
